I suppose this is where we learn to shoot each other better.
ZH: 我猜这里就是我们学习如何更好地互相射击的地方。

EN: I had no idea humans were capable of these movements!
ZH: 我没想到人类竟然能做出这些动作！

EN: Pardon me, monsieur, I would like a drink.
ZH: 请见谅，先生，我想来一杯酒。

EN: I will do my best to provide a balanced meal. Even with such… inferior ingredients.
ZH: 我会尽我所能提供均衡的一餐。即便用的是这些……劣质食材。

EN: Settle down, class! It is lecture time!
ZH: 安静，同学们！现在是讲课时间！

EN: What should we learn about first? Diagnostics? Biochemistry?
ZH: 我们先学什么好呢？诊断学？生物化学？

EN: Keeping the body strong is one of the best ways to stay healthy!
ZH: 强健体魄是保持健康的最佳途径之一！

EN: Games of chance? What benefit does this bring to humanity?
ZH: 碰运气的游戏？这对人类有什么益处呢？

EN: May I try rolling the dice? Perhaps I will understand its purpose if I engage in the activity.
ZH: 我可以试试掷骰子吗？也许亲自参与之后，我就能明白它的意义了。

EN: You are such a fascinating specimen.
Ah, I am living in a Vault once more. That is life...
ZH: 啊，我再一次住进避难所了。这就是生活……

EN: Do not squander opportunities to effect positive change.
ZH: 不要浪费促成积极改变的机会。

EN: Can I help you?
What is it?
Do you need something?
What shall we talk about?
Can I help you with something?
Good evening! I am at your service.
I wish there were sunlight in the Vault.
ZH: 真希望避难所里能有阳光。

EN: Do you require medical assistance?
Would anyone like to go for a walk outside? Get some fresh air?
ZH: 有人想出去散散步吗？呼吸点新鲜空气？

EN: There is always much to do. But all I want to do is research.
ZH: 总是有很多事要做。可我满脑子只想做研究。

EN: I am a scientist, but now I do chores. Perhaps I can automate these…
ZH: 我是一名科学家，可现在却在干杂活。也许我可以把这些活儿自动化……

EN: If you have any problems with my service, speak to the Overseer.
ZH: 如果您对我的服务有任何意见，请向监督者反映。

EN: Good morning! Or, is it the evening?
ZH: 早上好！哦，还是说现在是傍晚？

EN: This Vault is so much more functional than my previous home.
ZH: 这座避难所比我之前住的地方实用多了。

EN: The Vault has some truly amazing technology.
ZH: 这座避难所确实拥有一些真正令人惊叹的科技。

EN: It is so confined here. I suppose will distract myself with work.
ZH: 这里太局促了。我想我会用工作来转移注意力。

EN: If only we could all live outside. But, it is not very nice out there either.
ZH: 要是我们都能住在外面就好了。不过，外面也不太好过。

EN: Are you well? Can I get you something?
ZH: 您还好吗？需要我为您拿点什么吗？

EN: Anyone would like to be a test subject for me? I promise no harm will come to you! I hope…
ZH: 有人愿意当我的试验对象吗？我保证不会伤害到您！但愿如此……

EN: Welcome to your Vault! It is very nice, as far as Vaults go.
ZH: 欢迎来到您的避难所！就避难所而言，这儿相当不错了。

EN: Why do we not use stairs in the Vault? It would be much more healthy for our Dwellers.
ZH: 我们为什么不在避难所里使用楼梯呢？这对我们居民的健康会有好处。

EN: If anyone needs a checkup, I am here for that!
ZH: 如果有人需要体检，我随时都在！

EN: Always work with a partner, to reduce the risk of injury!
ZH: 锻炼时一定要找搭档，以降低受伤风险！

EN: Remember to stretch before and after your workout.
ZH: 记得在锻炼前后都要做拉伸。

EN: Oh! The color in this room is so spectacular! I wish to stay here forever.
ZH: 哦！这个房间的色彩太绚烂了！我真想永远待在这里。

EN: Please remember, proper sleep is the most important thing for mental health!
ZH: 请记住，充足的睡眠对心理健康是最重要的！

EN: I am told that dancing is very good exercise.
ZH: 我听说跳舞是很棒的运动。

EN: My Stimpaks have gone through extensive quality control. Would you like one?
ZH: 我的治疗针都经过了严格的质量把关。您想要一支吗？

EN: Do you need a Stimpak? I have made extra.
ZH: 您需要治疗针吗？我多做了一些。

EN: Some studies show drinking Nuka-Cola can be extremely habit forming. Bordering on addiction.
ZH: 有些研究表明，饮用核子可乐极易让人形成依赖。几乎可以说是成瘾。

EN: I love this room! Clothing is art and function. What better way is there to spend time?
ZH: 我爱这个房间！服装既是艺术，也是实用品。还有什么更好的方式打发时间吗？

EN: These machines are truly marvelous.
Please let me know if you would like an interview with me. I am a medical and scientific expert!
ZH: 如果您想采访我，请告诉我。我可是医学和科学专家！

EN: The power in this room is astounding. I can feel it in my circuits!
ZH: 这个房间里的能量惊人。我的电路里都能感受到它！

EN: Since the bombs fell, surely there have been scientific advances?
ZH: 自从核弹落下以来，科学一定已经取得了不少进展吧？

EN: I have made some medicine for you. If you like.
ZH: 我为您制作了一些药物。如果您愿意的话。

EN: Humans are so fixated on possessions that they dedicate entire rooms to hoarding them.
ZH: 人类如此执着于财物，以至于会腾出整个房间来囤积它们。

EN: It is such a pleasure to travel.
I do enjoy traveling. It is very satisfying.
ZH: 我确实喜欢旅行，这让我很满足。

EN: The offensive capabilities of this Deathclaw are quite advanced.
ZH: 这只死爪的攻击能力相当先进。

EN: Does no one in this Wasteland have manners any more?
ZH: 这片废土上难道再也没有人讲礼貌了吗？

EN: You should know that I am regrettably quite skilled in the use of violence.
ZH: 您该知道，很遗憾，我对暴力相当在行。

EN: Oh, no good can come from this.
An injured human! I will administer first aid and trauma stabilizers…
ZH: 一个受伤的人类！我会进行急救并使用创伤稳定剂……

EN: I have so much data! I have much to do once I am home.
ZH: 我积累了这么多数据！等回家后，我有好多事要做。

EN: The people out here seem most eager for violence, no?
ZH: 这里的人似乎对暴力趋之若鹜，不是吗？

EN: So many people, and so much technology, lost.
ZH: 这么多人、这么多科技，全都消逝了。

EN: And again with the killing... *sigh*
This is curious. Are not boats supposed to be in the water?
ZH: 这可真奇怪。船难道不是应该待在水里吗？

EN: Navigating the Wasteland is so complicated. Is there some sort of manual for it?
ZH: 穿越废土可真复杂。有什么使用手册之类的吗？

EN: Freedom at long last.
Out here, I can study some of the indigenous species!
ZH: 在这里，我可以研究一些当地的原生物种！

EN: Look! In the sky! Is it what we call a UFO?
ZH: 看！天上那是什么？那就是我们所说的不明飞行物吗？

EN: I detect enemies. I'm afraid I must neutralize them.
ZH: 我探测到敌人了。恐怕我得清除他们。

EN: I found a box of… Power Noodles? Sounds very nutritious.
ZH: 我发现一盒……能量面条？听起来很有营养。

EN: Oh, a Mr. Handy! But, I think this robot is broken.
ZH: 哦，一台巧手先生！不过，我想这个机器人是坏的。

EN: A Mole rat. What a fascinating specimen!
ZH: 一只鼹鼠。多么迷人的样本！

EN: A Super Mutant! So that is what the Forced Evolutionary Virus is capable of. Amazing.
ZH: 超级变种人！原来这就是强制进化病毒能做到的事。太了不起了。

EN: What a fascinating place.
What a strange place for a quarry.
ZH: 这里作为采石场可真奇怪。

EN: Those Ghouls were so aggressive! Are they what people call “feral”?
ZH: 那些尸鬼攻击性太强了！它们就是人们所说的“狂尸鬼”吗？

EN: Where are all the people?
Oh, look, a park.
Raiders! They do not look like they will negotiate. I will be forced to use violence again. Such a waste of life.
ZH: 掠夺者！他们看起来根本不打算谈判。我又要被迫诉诸武力了。真是浪费生命。

EN: Sample collected. I suspect it is partially digested meats and other biological matter.
ZH: 已采集样本。我怀疑是半消化的肉类和其他生物物质。

EN: I found a cadaver! I will stop a while to study it.
ZH: 我发现一具尸体！我要停留一会儿好好研究它。

EN: I believe that is a Yao Guai. The sight of them must give humans an enormous fear response.
ZH: 我相信那是妖怪熊。光是看到它们，就一定能让人类产生巨大的恐惧反应。

EN: My goodness, this is Power Armor! It is a technological marvel. Too bad this one is broken.
ZH: 我的天，这是动力装甲！这可是技术杰作。可惜这一件已经坏了。

EN: I see a Radstag. I wonder, with two heads, can it ever disagree with itself?
ZH: 我看到了一只辐射鹿。我很好奇，长着两个脑袋，它会不会自己跟自己吵架？

EN: I believe now is a good time to go North.
ZH: 我想现在是去北边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go East
ZH: 我想现在是去东边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go West
ZH: 我想现在是去西边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go South
ZH: 我想现在是去南边的好时机。

EN: I have been going North for some time. I will continue.
ZH: 我已经往北走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: I have been going East for some time. I will continue.
ZH: 我已经往东走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: I have been going West for some time. I will continue.
ZH: 我已经往西走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: I have been going South for some time. I will continue.
ZH: 我已经往南走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: Some Radroaches are approaching. Sadly, I must squish them.
ZH: 有几只辐射蟑螂正在靠近。很遗憾，我必须踩扁它们。

EN: There is something vile approaching. I can hear skittering.
ZH: 有某种恶心的东西正在靠近。我能听到窸窸窣窣的爬行声。

EN: I just met a group of traders with an enormous Brahmin. It is a wonderful creature!
ZH: 我刚遇到一群商人，带着一头巨大的双头牛。真是一只奇妙的生物！

EN: Hey, keep your hands off of me! I am not scrap metal!
I have found a field of fragmentation mines. It is horrible, how many ways humans kill each other.
ZH: 我发现了一片破片地雷场。人类互相残杀的方式之多，真是可怕。

EN: A bottle of alcohol. I wonder why humans are so attracted to this poison.
ZH: 一瓶酒。我好奇人类为什么对这种毒药如此着迷。

EN: Look at all the cars! Will any of them ever drive again?
ZH: 看看这些汽车！它们之中还有哪辆能再开动吗？

EN: They call my intelligence artificial, but I believe I am smarter than most of the people out here.
ZH: 他们说我的智能是人工的，但我认为我比这里大多数人都更聪明。

EN: A farm! An actual, active farm! It fills me with such hope. Perhaps civilization may bloom once more.
ZH: 一个农场！一个实实在在、运营中的农场！它让我满怀希望。也许文明能再次绽放。
